text:
Samir: Quick thread 1 planning the "Benchmark + Live Walkthrough" send. Target send: Thu 8:30AM PT for NA/EU, staggered 8:30AM SGT for APAC. Need copy, RSVP gating, routing, and suppression list.
Jules: Primary cohorts: trial-30d, engaged-newsletter (opened last 30d), benchmark-downloaders. I'd push downloaders into an "invite-first" bucket.
Rhea: Agree. For downloaders: include a subtle "book a demo" CTA after RSVP confirmation.
Marco: Subject line experiments: 1) "Live: behind our inference benchmark" 2) "How Redwood cut inference costs in production" — test personalization with company name for downloaders.
Nia: RSVP form proposal: short form with name, email, company, role, size, and "interested in demo?" checkbox. Add hidden fields: utm_campaign=benchmark_wk1, source=email, cohort={cohort}.
Samir: Routing logic: if role includes (Head|Director|CPO|CEO|PM|ML) OR company size > 500 -> route to sdr-enterprise. Else -> sdr-growth. Can we match on patterns?
Rhea: Yup. Pseudo-rule:
```
if (role =~ /(Head|Director|CPO|CEO|PM|ML)/ || company_size > 500) {
  owner = "sdr-enterprise"
} else {
  owner = "sdr-growth"
}
```
Jules: Also add a special route for benchmark-downloaders who previously engaged with docs: tag as "high-intent" and send booking link in confirmation.
Nia: Ops question: will form submissions create leads in Salesforce with correct lead source + UTM? deploy-bot: webhook deploy scheduled Wed 19:00 PT -> staging; CRM mapping will include utm fields.
Marco: Preheader ideas: "Thu 8:30AM PT 0min demo + Q&A" or "See latency & cost breakdowns live". Keep it under 80 chars.
Samir: Suppression rules: exclude anyone who RSVP'd or attended last 60 days, exclude unsubscribed emails, exclude bounce list. Also dedupe across cohorts (highest intent wins).
Rhea: For send splits: 10% subject A vs B for engaged-newsletter; include emoji A/B for trials. Keep downloaders out of subject test (send winner).
Jules: Creative: hero image with chart snapshot + short bullets: "latency, cost per token, batching wins, ops checklist". Add speaker panel and CTA to RSVP.
Nia: I'll export segments and drop CSV in /marketing/seg-exports/bench-webinar by EOD. Will also flag APAC timezone members for staggered send.
Marco: Calendar invite flow: confirmation page -> calendar add (ics) + optional "schedule 1:1" (if enterprise route). Don't show schedule button for small companies.
Samir: Action owners: Nia (segments & exports), Rhea (RSVP form + demo CTA logic), Jules (copy + subject tests), Marco (calendar flow + creatives), deploy-bot (webhook deployment). We'll do a 15m pre-send check Wed 3PM PT.
deploy-bot: Reminder: webhook deploy queued -> marketing/forms -> staging (Wed 19:00 PT).
Nia: Noted, will run a dry submit and confirm lead mapping in staging.
Jules: Copy drop ETA 90m in #copy-review. I'll include 3 subject lines and two preheaders.
Samir: Thanks team. One more: include a small survey question in RSVP: "primary reason for attending" (options: benchmarking, cost reduction, ops). Helps tie post-webinar follow-up cadence.
Rhea: Good call. That will drive follow-up playbooks.
